intent.constraints: Edit only files inside your blast radius. Never edit package.json, pnpm-workspace.yaml, tsconfig.json, biome.json, vitest.config.ts, stryker.config.json, src/types/, config/, or docs/. No new dependencies. Node 26 runs .ts directly: every relative import ends in .ts, types are imported with 'import type', no enums, namespaces, parameter properties or decorators. Tests sit next to the code as *.test.ts and assert behaviour a caller can observe. Run 'pnpm install --frozen-lockfile' first, then use 'pnpm exec vitest run <dir>', 'pnpm exec tsc --noEmit' and 'pnpm exec biome check <dir>' until all pass (use 'pnpm exec biome check --write <dir>' to format). Do not run git; skein commits for you. Comments only for a non-obvious why. Out of scope (do not build): AI scoring, voice AI, booking, retry or restart of a call, dashboards, the under-10 fleet branch, voicemail, follow-up email, other script paths. Never invent prospect wording; placeholders stay placeholders.
